name: Yakyuuken de Pakopako Batsu Game ~Classmate no Bantou-san~
original_name: 野球拳でパコパコ罰ゲーム～クラスメイトの番頭さん～
source:
Your classmate challenges you to a game of rock, paper, strippers!
But what happens if you lose? A sexy penalty game, of course!
translation:
你的同学向你发起一场石头、布、脱衣舞游戏的挑战！
但如果你输了怎么办？当然是性感的点球游戏！
